title: Admit a herding slot's fallback:"default" model into the guard's configured set
action:
Two bee doors disagree today. `bee dispatch prepare` (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/prepare.rs:781-833, the Resolved::Herding arm) reads a herding slot's `fallback:"default"` and publishes `payload.fallback = {model: <default_models(runtime)[tier]>}` - for claude generation that is "sonnet" (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/models.rs:43-55). That is bee telling the orchestrator: on a failed herding run, re-dispatch through the Agent path on this model. But `bee hook model-guard` then refuses that exact model, because `configured_model_set` (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/model_guard.rs:428-443) only collects `Resolved::Model` slots and a herding slot resolves to `Resolved::Herding`. With `.bee/config.json` setting generation+extraction to `{kind:"herding", agent:..., fallback:"default"}`, the claude member set is just {opus, fable} and every prepared fallback dispatch is denied.

Fix, entirely inside packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/model_guard.rs:
1. Change `Slot::Herding` (l. 238-241) from a unit variant to one carrying the fallback flag, e.g. `Herding { fallback: bool }`. Keep the existing doc comment and add one line naming this cell's reason.
2. In `normalize_tier_value`, the herding branch (l. 287-291): set that flag true when and only when the slot object carries the LITERAL string `"default"` under key `fallback` - mirror drivers/models.rs normalize_tier_value, which round-trips `fallback` only for that literal. Any other value (absent, empty, mistyped, non-string) is false.
3. Leave `Resolved::Herding` a unit variant and leave `resolve_tier`/`resolve_advisor` returning it. The dispatch refusal must not change: an Agent/Task subagent still cannot BE a herding pane (herding-tier D5), and the two refusal messages that say so stay byte-identical.
4. In `configured_model_set` (l. 428-443): for each of extraction/generation/review, when that slot's raw `Slot` is `Herding { fallback: true }`, insert the trimmed non-empty string from `crate::verbs::drivers::models::default_models("claude")` for that same slot name. `default_models` is `pub(crate)`, so call it - do NOT re-type the haiku/sonnet/opus table in the hook, or the two doors drift again the next time one moves. Honour the same review-falls-back-to-generation rule resolve_tier uses only where it already applies; a herding review slot resolves on its own, so its default is "opus".
5. Do NOT add the advisor slot to this path: prepare.rs's own comment (l. 809-817) records that advisor has no default-model table entry and never takes a tier fallback.

Tests in the file's existing #[cfg(test)] block, following its established style: (a) a claude generation slot `{kind:"herding", agent:"x", fallback:"default"}` plus review:"opus" - a dispatch carrying `model: "sonnet"` with no tier marker is ALLOWED; (b) the same slot WITHOUT `fallback` - `model: "sonnet"` is still DENIED, and the existing refusal text is unchanged; (c) `fallback` set to something other than the literal "default" behaves like (b); (d) a herding review slot with fallback:"default" puts "opus" in the member set; (e) a dispatch that names `subagent_type: "bee-gather"` or carries `[bee-tier: generation]` against a herding slot is STILL denied exactly as before - this cell widens the model-membership check only, never the tier/transport check.

truths: A herding slot carrying fallback:"default" makes that slot's default model a member of the guard's configured set
A herding slot with no fallback field admits no model - the refusal is unchanged
The tier/transport refusals (marker-on-nameless-tier, subagent_type-for-herding-slot) are unchanged by this cell

artifacts.substantive: Slot::Herding carries the fallback flag, configured_model_set calls drivers::models::default_models, plus the five new tests; no TODO stubs

key_links: configured_model_set sources its default model from drivers::models::default_models, not a second hardcoded table
prohibitions: No edit to verbs/drivers/prepare.rs or verbs/drivers/models.rs
No new hardcoded model-name table inside the hook
No change to any existing guard refusal message

trace.outcome: The model-guard now admits exactly the models dispatch prepare can publish for a herding slot carrying fallback:default - generation and review only - so the two doors no longer contradict each other.
deviations: Cell lane raised from small to standard at creation time so the judge-required hooks/ root took a real independent read instead of a lane-small acknowledgement.

checks.evidence: model_guard.rs:466 `if matches!(raw, Slot::Null | Slot::Unset) && slot == "review"` is the same predicate as resolve_tier's model_guard.rs:396 — identical variants, identical slot guard. Not wider: probe with review={kind:cli,command:"codex exec -"} beside a herding generation slot carrying fallback:"default", payload {"model":"opus"} -> exit 2, `configured models (haiku, sonnet)`. A Native/Name/already-Herding review slot never re-points.

model_guard.rs:471 re-points only to &models.claude.generation; the default_models key stays the loop's slot (model_guard.rs:475-476), so "review" -> "opus" per verbs/drivers/models.rs:43-55. Probe (extraction "haiku", generation herding fallback:"default", review null) with payload {"model":"opus"} -> exit 0, where 21796e79 gave exit 2. Matches prepare.rs:818-830, which publishes default_models(runtime)[tier_token] with tier_token="review".

Re-derived from prepare.rs:33-39 (slot_for_kind: cell|gather -> generation, reviewer -> review, everything else -> advisor), prepare.rs:641 (the only resolve_tier call site) and the prepare.rs:820 CONFIGURABLE_SLOTS gate: prepare can publish only generation -> sonnet and review -> opus for claude, nothing for advisor and nothing for codex/opencode. The herding loop at model_guard.rs:461 is exactly [generation, review] over models.claude.* with default_models("claude"). Probe on the verbatim repo .bee/config.json: {"model":"haiku"} -> exit 2, `configured models (fable, opus, sonnet)`; a codex-herding probe with {"model":"sonnet"} -> exit 2, `configured models (haiku)` — no codex leak.

a_herding_review_slots_fallback_default_is_allowed_as_a_param (model_guard.rs:1692-1707) asserts exit 0 plus dispatch transport model-param and model opus. an_explicitly_null_review_slot_inherits_the_generation_herding_fallback (model_guard.rs:1709-1731) asserts exit 0 on the real payload as well as the member set, and fails if the :466 re-point is removed. a_herding_extraction_slots_fallback_admits_nothing (model_guard.rs:1733-1752) asserts exit 2, the exact refusal text, member list (opus, sonnet) and transport param-not-configured, and fails if extraction is re-added to the loop. All three assert the guard verdict, not the implementation.

git show f58aa91f --stat -> 1 file changed, 220 insertions, 5 deletions, hooks/model_guard.rs only. git diff 21796e79 f58aa91f is confined to configured_model_set (model_guard.rs:444-483) and the three new tests; no refusal-string line appears in the diff. verbs/drivers/prepare.rs and verbs/drivers/models.rs untouched; the only model-name source is crate::verbs::drivers::default_models (model_guard.rs:476), so there is no second table. Transport refusal probed live: {"subagent_type":"bee-gather"} -> exit 2, wording unchanged. cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml model_guard -> 40 passed, 0 failed.

The added code is only matches!/reference re-binding (model_guard.rs:465-472) plus a guarded if-let with !m.trim().is_empty() (model_guard.rs:475-479) — no unwrap, no indexing, no arithmetic. Malformed slot objects were already reduced by normalize_tier_value (model_guard.rs:296), which cannot panic. Advisor never enters the herding loop (model_guard.rs:461) and the advisor arm at :484 still requires Resolved::Model; default_models has no advisor key. The raw reads are models.claude.review and models.claude.generation only.

report.outcome: configured_model_set contributes a herding slot fallback:default model for the generation and review slots only, sourced from verbs/drivers default_models; tier and transport refusals unchanged.
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml model_guard — green (40 passed, 0 failed) — the cell changes one hook file and its own tests; also proved end to end by running the freshly built binary hook against the live .bee/config.json: model=sonnet exit 0, model=haiku exit 2, subagent_type=bee-gather exit 2 with the refusal text unchanged
deviations: Brief said to loop all three configurable slots; corrected to generation and review only, because prepare slot_for_kind maps cell|gather to generation and reviewer to review and never reaches extraction, so an extraction fallback model can never be published. Raised by the independent judge read.

Brief named the call path crate::verbs::drivers::models::default_models, which does not compile - drivers/mod.rs keeps mod models private and re-exports its items, so the call is crate::verbs::drivers::default_models. Same function, same table.
The execution worker w-hgf-1 was registered in state.workers after its dispatch rather than before it; the dispatch itself was a real subagent run, so the entry is accurate but late.
